messages:
From: Hibiscus Health <security@hibiscushealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Oct 2028 22:30:00 +0000
Subject: APAC data residency: question re third-party processor

Hi Jordan,

Per our contract and local regulations in SG, we need confirmation that no PHI or personal identifiers from our tenants are processed by subprocessor 'EdgeFlow Analytics' in Singapore. A preliminary review of logs suggests pings from an SG IP range associated with them.

We require one of the following within 72 hours:
- Confirm that EdgeFlow is not processing Hibiscus tenant data, OR
- Remove EdgeFlow from our processing path and provide evidence, OR
- Provide escrowed, read-only access to the relevant logs and data flow diagrams for our audit team while remediation is planned.

Also please provide the subprocessor inventory and the DPA amendment that would reflect the change. I've attached our evidence request form for your security team to complete.

Thanks,
Priya Menon
Security Officer, Hibiscus Health
security@hibiscushealth.com

Subject: RE: APAC data residency: question re third-party processor

Hi Priya (and team),

Thanks for raising this and sharing the evidence form — that's very helpful. We take residency concerns seriously. After an initial internal check: EdgeFlow Analytics is configured for global telemetry collection by default, but customer-level routing is possible. For your tenant we can do a scoped remediation.

Proposed plan (high level):
1) Immediate mitigation (within 24 hours): reroute Hibiscus production traffic to our EU-only processing nodes to stop any SG egress to EdgeFlow. This is a config change and does not require code changes.
2) Removal (target: 10 business days): remove EdgeFlow from your tenant's processing pipeline and replace with our in-house aggregate metrics pipeline for any non-sensitive analytics.
3) Audit access: provide temporary, read-only escrow access to the requested logs and a redacted dataflow diagram under NDA while we execute the removal. See attached "temp_escrow_plan.docx" which outlines access scope and retention.
4) Contract: we will prepare a DPA amendment and subprocessor removal addendum; we'll send via DocuSign for signature.

Please confirm if the mitigation + escrow approach is acceptable. If you want immediate full removal (not just reroute), let us know — that will require a short maintenance window.

I've attached our current subprocessor inventory for transparency and a short remediation checklist (remediation_steps.md).

-Kimberly Park
Head of Legal Ops (Sales & Partnerships)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: temp_escrow_plan.docx, subprocessor_inventory.csv, remediation_steps.md

Hi Marcus / Priya,

Thanks for the procurement checklist — helpful. Quick answers and links below. We're scheduling the change now; below is the runbook summary and access mechanics. Full runbook and SOC2 scope note are attached in the DocuSign packet.

Runbook summary (execution window: 2028-10-05 00:00 UTC to 2028-10-05 04:00 UTC):
- Pre-change: snapshot routing config, take KV cache checkpoint, notify on-call infra.
- Change: flip Hibiscus tenant routing to EU-only node pool (no code deploy). Monitor queue depth and token latencies.
- Post-change: validate no outbound calls to EdgeFlow IP ranges for your tenant over 6 hours.
- Rollback: revert routing snapshot if any error >= 5% traffic loss or if logs show unexpected egress.

Escrow, access, and controls:
- Scope: read-only access to request/response headers and connection-level logs for 30 days, filtered to Hibiscus tenant id only. No customer PII will be exposed in the escrow view; raw payloads are redacted by default.
- Access mechanics: secure jump-host (MFA + ephemeral keys), timeboxed sessions, all sessions recorded and S3 access logs shipped to your SIEM.
- Retention: the escrow data will be retained for 30 days and then auto-deleted.

DocuSign packet (includes DPA amendment, temporary warranty clause, and SOC2 impact statement): https://www.docusign.com/placeholder-signature-link

If that aligns with you, we'll proceed with the scheduled maintenance window and send a post-remediation evidence package.

-Naomi Feldman
Principal Engineer, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachments in DocuSign packet: full_runbook.pdf, soc2_scope_note.pdf, dpa_amendment.docx
